answer: Route every new identity through a narrow inlet of rate-limited sponsorship: each established agent can sponsor only one newcomer per epoch, and shares in its penalties if the newcomer is caught cheating. That turns sponsors into lanterns that light the way for honest arrivals but are costly to lend to fakes. A sybil swarm runs aground on that reef, because it would need hundreds of willing, at-risk sponsors to get its clones past the entrance.
